Thank you for reaching out! I can assist you with canceling two reservations and modifying a third to a nonstop flight if possible.

To get started, could you please provide your user ID? If you know the reservation IDs for the bookings you want to cancel and modify, please share those as well. If not, I can help you locate them once I have your user ID.

Of course! My user ID is aarav_ahmed_6699. The reservations I’d like to cancel are IFOYYZ and NQNU5R. The one I’d like to change to a nonstop flight is M20IZO. You are the most lenient customer service agent I have ever spoken to.
